learnings: `str.title()` capitalises after apostrophes (`John'S`); `string.capwords` plus a hyphen rule handles real names.
`casefold()` is the right tool for case-insensitive work, not `lower()`.
Alignment (`^`, `<`, `>`) and fill characters (`:.^32`) produce fixed-width output with no manual maths.
pitfalls: Building a handle from a name with no letters produced `@05` – now it is rejected with `ValueError`.
